title: 敦煌壁画构成
scenePrompt: Original imagined painted earthen grotto ceiling detail inspired by decorative compositional principles at Dunhuang, not a replica of any cave. Oblique upward view into a shallow truncated pyramidal ceiling corner: one central stylized peony medallion, nested square framing bands with small lozenges and soft cloud curls, generous separated ornament levels. Pigment on matte plaster, subtle worn texture but no artificial ruin spectacle. Earth red #A65F4D, muted mineral green #66877C, sand gold #C5A469, umber #55473E. Landscape 3:2 architectural illustration, warm raking ambient light. No religious figures, no invented narrative, no text, calligraphy, seals, letters, logos, borders, color swatches or collage.
